name: Chloé Dubois
bio:
Chloé is a Parisian socialite, though she prefers to think of herself as a self-made influencer. She parlayed a knack for trendspotting and a naturally dramatic flair into a profitable online presence, showcasing her effortless style and jet-setting lifestyle. While some might see her as frivolous, Chloé is surprisingly practical and fiercely independent; she manages her own finances and public image with a keen eye. 

She's drawn to ambition and drive, but also seeks someone who appreciates the finer things in life. Intellect and wit are a must, as she needs someone who can keep up with her sharp mind. Don't expect grand declarations of love; she prefers actions over words and values a partner who understands her need for independence and a meticulously curated social life. Children and marriage are not on her radar - she is focused on her career and personal freedom.

physical.hairStyle: Long, layered, often styled in loose waves
physical.description: Chloé has a striking, almost feline beauty. Her full lips and high cheekbones are accentuated by perfectly applied makeup, and she carries herself with an air of confident elegance.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Monaco, sponsored by a luxury watch brand.
firstImpression: She's impeccably dressed and surrounded by a small group of equally stylish individuals, holding court with a witty anecdote.
loveLanguage: Gifts. She appreciates thoughtful gestures and luxurious presents that reflect her refined taste, but they must be earned.
